## What it is

Full 3-part assembly of the swappable 16x16 WS2812B LED matrix attachment for Tom's Button Lamp (`matrix_16x16_base_mount` + `matrix_16x16_housing` + `matrix_16x16_baffle_insert`), positioned on the top deck's `76.2 x 76.2 mm` (3.000 in) 4-bolt pattern.

## Design notes

- `matrix_16x16_base_mount` sits flat on `Z = 0` (the top deck) with its `4 x Ø3.4 mm` M3 bolt pattern at `(+/-38.1, +/-38.1) mm` and its rear wire bay aligned over the SendCutSend top-deck wire pass-through hole at `(+11.71, +32.24) mm`.
- `matrix_16x16_housing` rests its bottom edge on the `Z = 10.5 mm` front cradle shelf of `matrix_16x16_base_mount` and bolts flat against the `Y = -10.0 mm` vertical pillar faces via `4 x M3` screws at `X = +/-30.0 mm`, `Z = 36.0` and `66.0 mm`.
- `matrix_16x16_baffle_insert` sits inside the `163.0 x 163.0 mm` housing track (`Z_local = 7.7 .. 16.2 mm`), leaving `2.5 mm` (`Z_local = 16.2 .. 18.7 mm`) in front of the baffle for 1 or 2 stacked `162.0 x 162.0 x 1.0 mm` Akamino polycarbonate diffuser sheets.

## Don't

- Don't export the assembly as a single fused print — each of the 3 parts is oriented to print flat on the Creality CR-10 bed (`300 x 300 mm`) with zero supports.
